q: Should we link staff incentives to a carbon target?
title: Carbon targets in staff incentives
short: Only once the figure is reliable. Reward what a team controls, such as diesel per tonne or kWh per piece, measured from bills and meters. Avoid rewarding a total that can fall because output fell, and check the data before paying out.
audience: Plant heads and owners setting team goals

ul: Energy or fuel per unit of output.
Compressed air leaks fixed per month.
Share of bills recorded on time.
Totals that drop when production drops.
Estimates replaced by guesses to hit a number.
Paying before a second person checks the data.

senseible: Senseible keeps every bill, invoice and calculation in one dated, fingerprinted record, so the evidence behind each figure can be found again by anyone who checks it.
